comment: The scope lists "medicines, vaccines, medical devices, diagnostics, and health commodities" but does not mention medical equipment. Important to distinguish for many reasons, e.g., "diagnostics" covers both test kits and equipment. Equipment needs different attributes that don't necessarily fit the model.
